test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

She d__oes not helping to getting angry__ when she sees someone being treated unfairly.

options.text: is not help to being getting angry
may not help to got angry
will not help to gets angry

solution:
The correct answer is '**cannot help getting angry**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **most appropriate** option to improve the underlined part of the given sentence is '**cannot help getting angry**'.
 
• The expression '**can't help getting angry**' is **used to talk about becoming angry about something**.
 
• The underlined sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• *The words do/does are not used with words that are in continuous tense, i.e. verbs following 'ing'*.
 
• Hence, the **most appropriate** answer is '**can't help getting angry**'.
